hints.tr: Yazım: `CREATE INDEX ad ON tablo (sütun);`. Adı sen seçiyorsun; alışkanlık `ix_tablo_sütun`.
hints.en: The syntax: `CREATE INDEX name ON table (column);`. You pick the name; the habit is `ix_table_column`.

hints.tr: Dizini adıyla değil yapısıyla denetliyorum: `events` üzerindeki (birincil anahtar dışındaki) dizinlerin anahtar sütunlarına, eklenen sütunlarına ve süzgecine bakılıyor. Tek bir dizin kur.
hints.en: The index is checked by its structure, not its name: the key columns, included columns and filter of the indexes on `events` (other than the primary key). Create a single index.

hints.tr:
Sorgunun tamamı:

```sql
CREATE INDEX ix_events_created ON events (created_at);
```
hints.en:
The whole query:

```sql
CREATE INDEX ix_events_created ON events (created_at);
```

checks.query: SELECT STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN ic.is_included_column = 0 THEN c.name END, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal, c.name) AS key_columns, STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN ic.is_included_column = 1 THEN c.name END, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal, c.name) AS included_columns, i.is_unique, i.filter_definition FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id = i.object_id AND ic.index_id = i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id = ic.object_id AND c.column_id = ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id = OBJECT_ID('events') AND i.is_primary_key = 0 GROUP BY i.index_id, i.is_unique, i.filter_definition ORDER BY key_columns;
